why: The device-vibration gate. Without it a stored `deviceHaptics: true` reaches haptics.ts on a browser with no `navigator.vibrate` at all -- which per haptics.ts's own support note is every Safari and Firefox user, on any OS. Killed by effective-settings.test.ts's 2x2 stored-x-capability sweep and by loop.test.ts's 'gates the haptics director on device VIBRATION', which enters through startGameWith. 7 of 385 across the two declared files.
